title: Synthetic Mental Health Data Generation
summary: A graduate-level pipeline that trains custom VAE and CTGAN models to generate privacy-safe synthetic tabular data from NHANES and DASS-42 mental health survey datasets, evaluating fidelity, utility, and privacy risk. SDV's TVAESynthesizer is imported and run in baselines/tvae_baseline.py as a comparison baseline against the project's own VAE/CTGAN models.
needs: models/ctgan directory flagged as possible vendored copy but no evidence shown of actual SDV/ctgan source being copied vs. a custom implementation named 'ctgan'.
